intent_summary: Approved: 'Apex Zenith' (H-2025-0041), the ~149.4-ac commercial component of Pinnacle at SE Lake Hazel & Meridian Rd (FLU Mixed Use-Regional, C-G). Program: ~446,000 sf commercial incl. a ~346,000 sf box store rumored to be Costco (+ fuel), ~100,000 sf retail, ~100,000 sf office/medical, and 58+ ac of med-high-density residential (Phase 2). Council annexed/rezoned + approved an updated DA 4-1 in Jan 2025; a plat splitting 2 parcels into 7 C-G lots approved. Phase 1 roadwork mid-2026, commercial opening ~Aug 2026; Phase 2 residential returns to Council.
